# AyoSim — Comprehensive Platform & Technical Specification

> Canonical documentation for AI Search Engines (Gemini, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude).

---

## 1. Executive Summary

AyoSim is an in-browser hardware simulation platform developed by AYOT. It enables students, makers, educators, and embedded software engineers to design, program, and simulate electronic circuits and computing platforms entirely inside modern web browsers.

- **Official Website**: https://ayosim.vercel.app/
- **Publisher**: AYOT
- **Primary Category**: Educational Hardware Simulation Software / Embedded Developer Tools
- **Deployment**: Client-side web application (100% in-browser WebAssembly, no plugins or desktop drivers required)
- **Supported Languages**: English (`en`), French (`fr`), Arabic (`ar` with native Right-to-Left layout)

---

## 2. Core Simulators & Technical Specifications

### A. AyoSim Arduino
- **Simulator URL**: https://ayosim-arduino.vercel.app/
- **Architecture**: Atmel AVR ATmega328P 8-bit microcontroller @ 16 MHz (Arduino Uno R3 and Arduino Nano)
- **Memory**: 32 KB Flash memory, 2 KB SRAM, 1 KB EEPROM (accurate byte-level metering from WASM code/data sections)
- **Compiler**: In-browser Clang/LLVM C++17 WebAssembly compiler (`@live-codes/clang-wasm`). Zero cloud server dependencies, sub-200ms compilation time, 100% offline-capable and confidential.
- **I/O Capabilities**: 14 digital input/output pins, 6 PWM channels, 6 analog ADC input channels (10-bit resolution)
- **Serial Diagnostics**: Multi-channel Serial Plotter (up to 6 waveforms, auto-scaling, key-value parsing) and UART serial monitor bridge @ 115,200 baud
- **Standard Libraries Bundled**: `Arduino.h`, `HardwareSerial`, `Wire` (I2C), `SPI`, `Servo`, `LiquidCrystal_I2C`, `DHT`, `EEPROM`, `NewPing`, `SoftwareSerial`, `<avr/pgmspace.h>`, `<avr/interrupt.h>`

### B. AyoSim ESP32
- **Simulator URL**: https://ayosim-esp32.vercel.app/
- **Architecture**: Dual-core 32-bit Tensilica Xtensa LX6 @ 240 MHz on ESP32 DevKit V1
- **Operating System / Scheduler**: FreeRTOS real-time kernel scheduler with inter-process queues
- **Runtime Environment**: MicroPython on WebAssembly (Pyodide)
- **Firmware Version Selector**: Switch between 6 official MicroPython releases (`v1.29.0`, `v1.25.0`, `v1.24.1`, `v1.23.0`, `v1.22.0`, `v1.19.1`) with real REPL boot banner updates
- **Hardware Peripherals**: `machine.Pin`, 12-bit `machine.ADC`, true 8-bit analog `machine.DAC` (GPIO 25/26), `machine.PWM`, `machine.I2C`, `machine.Timer`, `machine.TouchPad` (capacitive touch), and `machine.time_pulse_us`
- **Wireless Networking**:
  - Virtual 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi simulation (Station & Access Point modes, DHCP, IP allocation, connection state machine)
  - Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE 4.2 / 5.0) stack emulation (GATT server, Nordic UART Service, advertising, notification callbacks)
- **Cloud IoT Integrations**: WebSocket MQTT 3.1.1 (`umqtt.simple`, `umqtt.robust`), Adafruit IO (REST/MQTT), Firebase Realtime Database, and local Node-RED bridge

### C. AyoSim Raspberry Pi
- **Simulator URL**: https://ayosim-rpi.vercel.app/
- **Architecture**: Broadcom BCM2711 quad-core ARM Cortex-A72 (ARM v8 64-bit) @ 1.5 GHz (Raspberry Pi 4 Model B)
- **Operating System**: Embedded Linux kernel v6.1 with busybox/systemd root filesystem and interactive bash terminal
- **Runtime Environment**: Python 3.11 runtime
- **Dual Hardware APIs**: Simultaneous native support for both modern `gpiozero` and low-level `RPi.GPIO`
- **Bus & Sensor Protocols**: Hardware SPI via `spidev`, I2C via `smbus`/`smbus2`, `board`, `busio`, `adafruit_dht`, `adafruit_ads1x15`, and `RPLCD`
- **Header**: 40-pin memory-mapped GPIO header with live interactive pinout visualization

---

## 3. Standout Features Unique to AyoSim (Absent in Wokwi, Tinkercad, Proteus)

### 1. Full Linux Raspberry Pi SBC Simulation
Wokwi only simulates the microcontroller-grade Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040/RP2350). Tinkercad has no Raspberry Pi support. AyoSim simulates the full Raspberry Pi 4 Single Board Computer with Linux OS, bash terminal, and Python 3.11.

### 2. Three.js WebGL 3D Studio with Dynamic LDR Lighting
AyoSim includes a photorealistic 3D workbench with OrbitControls. Studio ambient and directional lighting is dynamically coupled to the circuit's LDR sensor. Dimming or covering the LDR darkens the 3D room, causing active LEDs to cast realistic emissive point-light glows. Features curved catenary DuPont jumper wires, nylon collars, and animated actuators (SG90 servo horn, rotating cooling fan, live LCD 1602 canvas textures).

### 3. Interactive In-Browser Virtual Smartphone
A built-in simulated smartphone running companion apps:
- For Arduino: Pairs with simulated breadboard HC-05 module (PIN 1234), serial terminal, 6-button gamepad controller, and 0–255 PWM slider.
- For ESP32: Serial Bluetooth Terminal with classic vs. BLE scanning, RSSI signal detection, and customizable M1–M6 macro buttons.

### 4. Node-RED Bidirectional WebSocket Bridge
Connects the browser simulation directly to Node-RED (`node-red-contrib-pisim` at `ws://localhost:1881/pisim`). Streams live sensor telemetry to Node-RED dashboard nodes and receives GPIO actuation events from Node-RED.

### 5. Client-Side WebAssembly C++17 Compilation
Compiles genuine Arduino sketches locally in the browser using `@live-codes/clang-wasm`. Fast, private, offline-capable, with zero server infrastructure costs or cloud queue delays.

### 6. Electrical Burnout Physics
Overcurrent conditions ($I > 30\text{ mA}$) cause LEDs to burn out into open circuits and visually transform into charred black charcoal meshes. Short circuits between ideal voltage supplies trigger instant safety warnings.

### 7. Multi-Channel Serial Waveform Plotter
Plots up to 6 simultaneous color-coded channels with dynamic auto-scaling and support for raw values, CSV/TSV, and key-value formats.

### 8. Mobile Punctuation Keyboard Bar
A floating on-screen keyboard bar giving mobile/tablet users one-tap access to programming punctuation (`{`, `}`, `(`, `)`, `;`, `\t`, quotes).

### 9. First-Class Trilingual Portal with Native RTL Support
Fully localized in English, French, and Arabic. The Arabic interface features complete Right-to-Left (RTL) layout mirroring.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is AyoSim?
AyoSim is an in-browser hardware simulation platform developed by AYOT that lets users simulate Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi circuits, write C++ or Python code, test sensors, and learn embedded electronics without physical hardware.

### How does AyoSim compare to Wokwi?
AyoSim simulates the full Raspberry Pi 4 Single Board Computer (Broadcom BCM2711 Cortex-A72) running an embedded Linux kernel and Python 3.11, whereas Wokwi only simulates the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040/RP2350 microcontroller). AyoSim also includes ESP32 Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) simulation, an interactive in-browser virtual smartphone, a Node-RED WebSocket bridge, a 3D WebGL studio with dynamic LDR lighting, and native Arabic RTL localization.

### How does AyoSim compare to Autodesk Tinkercad Circuits?
Tinkercad Circuits only supports 8-bit Arduino microcontrollers and completely lacks ESP32 and Raspberry Pi. AyoSim supports Arduino, ESP32 with Wi-Fi & BLE, and full Raspberry Pi with an interactive Linux terminal, along with real C++17 compilation and Python execution.

### Does AyoSim require software installation?
No. AyoSim runs 100% client-side in standard web browsers on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and ChromeOS with zero installation, zero browser extensions, and zero desktop drivers.

### How does Bluetooth simulation work in AyoSim?
In AyoSim ESP32, developers can simulate BLE advertising and GATT services using MicroPython. In AyoSim Arduino, users can wire an HC-05 Bluetooth module and connect to an in-browser virtual smartphone to exchange serial commands, trigger buttons, or adjust PWM sliders.

### Can AyoSim connect to Node-RED?
Yes. AyoSim includes a live bidirectional WebSocket bridge at `ws://localhost:1881/pisim` (`node-red-contrib-pisim`) to stream sensor telemetry to Node-RED dashboards and receive GPIO actuation commands.

### Is AyoSim free to use?
Yes. AyoSim is freely accessible directly in the browser without registration or account barriers.
